doomed_traits_additions.category.title: Doomed traits additions
doomed_traits_additions.category.conflic: Dementia cannot be combined with Bright.
doomed_traits_additions.fx.gun: A weapon at your temple! Press SPACE!
doomed_traits_additions.trait.lactose_in: Anything containing milk or dairy (milk, cheese, cream, butter, cake and so on) makes you vomit when consumed.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.dementia.b: Thoughts slip away, and learning gets harder.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.dementia.e: Start at Intelligence 6 instead of 10, and Intelligence experience is gained 25% slower. Cannot be taken together with Bright.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.sociophobi: Other people nearby are a strain in themselves.
Within about 6 blocks of other players or Doomed traders, your mood slowly worsens. The effect stops once your mood falls to -45.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.vegetarian: Any food with meat makes you vomit and costs -10 mood. While RBC is below 75% you can eat meat: mood drops only -5, but a 20% chance of vomiting remains.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.anorexia.b: The body has long forgotten how to hold weight.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.anorexia.e: You start severely underweight (not lethal). Strength and Resilience start at 8 instead of 10, and their experience is gained 25% slower.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.opiate_imm: To you, fentanyl is just water.
Opiates do nothing to you: morphine, fentanyl, opium, heroin and opiate pills. Non-opiate painkillers work normally.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.hardcore_s: Your fluffy friend is here. Usually he is kind.
Your fluffy friend talks to you. Every 2-10 min (1-6 with brain damage, 6-15 with mood above 20) a random hallucination hits: footsteps, fake vitals, inverted controls, a quarrel with your friend...
doomed_traits_additions.trait.chain_smok: Your hand reaches for a cigarette on its own.
Every 5 minutes you are driven to smoke (needs a cigarette and a light); the craving never fades. In return, tar barely builds up in your lungs and slowly clears over time.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.iron_sleep: Napping works on any surface as if on wool. After a night in a bed, your vigor lasts 5 minutes longer.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.cannibal.e: Human flesh has no ill effect on you, you even enjoy it (+4 mood). But players within 6 blocks without this trait lose 3 mood.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.genius.blu: You do not know more than others yet, but you learn twice as fast.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.genius.eff: Intelligence experience is gained twice as fast.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.in_shape.b: Your body is ready for anything.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.in_shape.e: Strength and Resilience start at 12, and their experience is gained 25% faster.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.iron_stoma: Your body is used to all sorts of filth.
Poisoning from any source is halved, and chemical fumes barely affect you.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.optimist.e: Mood worsens 30% less, and things that give mood give slightly more. A weaker version also applies to players within 6 blocks.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.focused.bl: A bad mood does not stop you.
doomed_traits_additions.trait.focused.ef: You never refuse to do things (such as picking items up) because of a low mood.
